title: A day at your nursery, from open to close
lead: Your nursery probably runs on a WhatsApp group today. Here is the same day without it.
timelineLabel: A day at your nursery, hour by hour

items.title: Drop-off
items.body: A parent taps check-in at the gate. The button only works within the distance you set. No book, no queue, no tablet.
items.alt: Parent app showing today's attendance with a Check In button

items.title: Room overview
items.body: The teacher sees who is in, who is late and who is absent. Marking a child in by hand takes one tap.
items.alt: Teacher view of the class attendance list with a Mark as Checked-in button

items.title: Photos
items.body: Each photo goes straight to that child's own gallery, not into a group where twelve families scroll to find theirs.
items.alt: Media gallery screen showing the day's photos of a child

items.title: Daily activities
items.body: Meals, nap, mood, nappies, medication: noted as they happen, not from memory at half past four.
items.alt: Child Daily Logs screen with mood options

items.title: Peace of mind at work
items.body: At her desk, a mother opens the app. Without messaging anyone, she sees what her child ate, how long they slept and this morning's photos.
items.alt: Parent app home screen beside the day details with meals, nap and photos

items.title: Daily report
items.body: One tap sends the day. Every parent gets a notification in their own language, and the report stays searchable.
items.alt: Draft daily log screen beside a Published Successfully confirmation

items.title: Questions, answered in one place
items.body: Parents message the nursery in the app, follow their child's day, and every update stays in one chat.
items.alt: A parent holding a phone that shows a chat with the nursery

summary.title: The day, all in one place
summary.body: Nothing lost in a group chat. Nothing written twice. Nothing arriving at midnight.
summary.alt: Notices, a class update and an attendance overview above the Yawmy Care app
